contentPattern: xwalk tabs-style item rows: one row per product card: cell 1 = tab label (rows with the same label are grouped into one panel; first row of a tab may carry the tab icon image), cell 2 = card icon image, cell 3 = card title (h2/strong), benefit paragraph(s), primary CTA link, secondary link. Optional card theme (blue/red/plum/black/chocolate) authored as a classes/select field.
